workItem: Restore the visible email login/registration/recovery controls on /login using the canonical SvenKulessa/FRONTEND LoginPage design while preserving the merged backend-first authentication authority.
workItemDE: E-Mail-Anmeldung, Registrierung und Passwort-vergessen auf /login im kanonischen FRONTEND-Design wieder sichtbar machen und ausschließlich an die backend-first Auth-Endpunkte anbinden
priorityReason: Backend email authentication is productive but the public login page exposes only Google, blocking ordinary users from discovering registration and recovery.
scopeBoundary: Browser presentation may POST credentials only to same-origin backend auth endpoints; no direct Supabase auth client calls are reintroduced.
Google OAuth remains available in parallel through /api/auth/login/google.
Registration uses /api/auth/register; email login uses /api/auth/login/email; recovery uses /api/auth/password/forgot; confirmation resend uses /api/auth/confirmation/resend.
CAPITAL-AI-OPS remains owner of backend auth, Supabase and Stripe runtime semantics; this FE slice does not change those contracts.
Legacy billing convergence was executed separately under fresh owner direction and is evidence/dependency only, not FE-owned implementation.

evidence.backendFoundation: PR #1273 merged email registration/login/recovery backend endpoints.
evidence.openWriterOverlap: No open login/registration/auth PR at branch creation.
evidence.legacyBillingConvergence: Verified live after mutation: 2 legacy public.users rows, 2 converged, 0 divergent; 46 public.usage_log rows preserved. Enterprise legacy row now mirrors the canonical active subscription/customer; stale GMX Pro/Stripe references were cleared to canonical Free.

acceptanceCriteria: /login visibly exposes Anmelden and Registrieren tabs in the pinned FRONTEND design language.
Email/password login POSTs only to /api/auth/login/email and redirects to / after an authenticated response.
Registration POSTs only to /api/auth/register and shows confirmation-mail guidance.
Password-forgot POSTs only to /api/auth/password/forgot and remains enumeration-resistant in UI wording.
No supabase.auth, direct token, localStorage auth or sessionStorage auth logic is introduced in LoginPage.
Relevant frontend/auth tests and required repository checks pass on exact head.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
